Proyect1.Body: Enjoy classic Blackjack right in your browser. A fully developed experience using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, perfect for playing seamlessly on any device.

Proyect2.Body: Test your wits by guessing a number between 1 and 10,000. Built with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, it saves your wins and records in your browser's local storage.

Proyect5.Body: Pomodoro Timer in a web version with fully customizable work and break intervals. It includes an alarm sound and uses Web Workers to run in the background. It lets you stay focused without needing to watch the window or tab, offering maximum flexibility and control over your productivity sessions.

Proyect6.Body: A simple idle game where your clicks are tied to the real-time value of Bitcoin using Binance API. Built with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, it offers an engaging experience that combines gameplay with real-world cryptocurrency dynamics.

Proyect3.Body: isc-dhcp-setup is a script that allows you to quickly install and configure an ISC-DHCP server on Debian/Ubuntu-based systems. It simplifies defining the network interface, IP range, gateway, DNS, and lease times, with default values available if desired. Ideal for deploying a functional DHCP server quickly and easily.

Proyect4.Body: A simple tool that allows you to download YouTube videos and songs automatically and without ads. It offers a Python version that requires ffmpeg installed, and an .exe version that needs no additional installation.
